SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, min(d.calendar_date) mn, max(d.calendar_date) mx,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN min(d.calendar_date) AND max(d.calendar_date)) lines,

SELECT date_trunc('month', d1) m, count(*) groups, sum(n) rows, sum(CASE WHEN n1=n2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_amt, sum(CASE WHEN d1=d2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_date, sum(CASE WHEN s1=s2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_store, min(e1), max(e2), min(a), max(b)
FROM k GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sales_dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week<=22),
store_weeks AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date>=w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900
),
lfl AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty
  JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) ns, count(DISTINCT n.store_id) nstores
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  JOIN lfl l ON l.store_id=n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=d.fiscal_week
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.nstores, ty.ns this_year, ly.ns last_year, ROUND(100.0*(ty.ns/ly.ns-1),2) lfl_pct,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.ns/ly.ns DESC) rnk
FROM agg ty JOIN agg ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY rnk

WITH sales_dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
mine AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, sum(v) mine, sum(b) mine_before FROM (
  SELECT f.sale_date business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount v, f.net_amount b
  FROM sales_dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 0
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') GROUP BY 1,2
),
cmp AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, coalesce(m.store_id, r.store_id) store_id, m.business_date, coalesce(m.mine,0) mine, coalesce(r.net_sales,0) rpt
  FROM mine m FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900) r ON r.business_date=m.business_date AND r.store_id=m.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=coalesce(m.business_date, r.business_date)
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, count(*) n, round(sum(mine),2) mine, round(sum(rpt),2) rpt, round(sum(mine)-sum(rpt),2) diff, sum(CASE WHEN abs(mine-rpt)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_cells
FROM cmp GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING abs(sum(mine)-sum(rpt))>0.05 OR sum(CASE WHEN abs(mine-rpt)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY 1,2
